sections.text: A conditional planning estimate is available. It depends on the accepted assumptions and is not a guarantee of production performance. Treat the saved result as a planning view for discussion, not as sign-off. Remaining unknowns need architect review before any commitment.

The workload estimate is 40 GPUs. The selected factory deployment anchor is 256 GPUs. These are different quantities. HGX_B300: 40 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 32 to 56). HGX_B200: 48 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 40 to 72). HGX_H200: 72 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 56 to 104). Counts use whole GPU nodes. Spare compute does not establish an admitted tenant count. Sensitivity is not a confidence interval. The factory size shown is a planning estimate, and spare capacity is not a promise that extra work can be accepted. Hardware choice and workload estimate serve different purposes.

Required memory per GPU: 40 GB. Selected hardware memory per GPU: 288 GB. Host RAM provision for the workload: 10240 GB. Host local disk provision: 153600 GB. Host provisions are planning assumptions. Per-device memory fit matters, not just aggregate memory. Memory is about whether each device can hold the working set, not just total memory across the factory. Host memory and local disk figures are planning inputs that the architect should confirm.

No local shared-storage capacity has been established. This is not a zero-storage requirement. An outside corpus is not automatically copied into this factory. Treat missing shared storage as an open requirement, not as no need. Any outside data must be brought in through a planned transfer rather than assumed present.

External customer datacenter ingress: unresolved. North-south ingress: unresolved. Dedicated storage read/write links: unresolved / unresolved. East-west link per GPU: unresolved. Storage networking is physically dedicated, not converged. External and north-south rates describe the same traffic at different boundaries and must not be added together. These are lower bounds, not selected circuit sizes. Traffic entering the factory and communication between GPUs are still open items. The saved figures are lower bounds and should not be added across boundaries.
